description: Add modules M10-M16 to the Fixed Income question data file (186 questions total for M10-M19, this covers M10-M16 = 145 questions)
steps: Append to src/features/question-bank/data/fixed-income.ts after the existing module9Questions
Module 10: Interest Rate Risk and Return (25 Qs) - Interest rate risk/return, investment horizon, duration gap, reinvestment risk
Module 11: Yield-Based Bond Duration Measures (26 Qs) - Macaulay duration, modified duration, effective duration, key rate duration
Module 12: Yield-Based Bond Convexity and Portfolio (28 Qs) - Convexity, duration+convexity approximation, portfolio duration, portfolio convexity
Module 13: Curve-Based and Empirical Risk Measures (33 Qs) - Key rate duration, empirical duration, spread duration, DV01
Module 14: Credit Risk (13 Qs) - Credit risk components (POD, LGD, expected loss), credit rating, migration
Module 15: Credit Analysis for Government Issuers (7 Qs) - Sovereign credit analysis, fiscal/monetary policy, institutional framework
Module 16: Credit Analysis for Corporate Issuers (20 Qs) - Corporate credit analysis (4 Cs), ratios, structural/reduced-form models
acceptance_criteria: Module arrays added: module10Questions(25), module11Questions(26), module12Questions(28), module13Questions(33), module14Questions(13), module15Questions(7), module16Questions(20)
All questions are substantive CFA content with proper explanations
